survey.title: A Survey on Efficient Inference for Large Language Models

criteria: Core: makes inference of large language models (transformer LMs) faster, cheaper or lighter in memory.

Data-level (prompt compression, output organization), model-level (quantization, pruning, low-rank or knowledge distillation for deployment, efficient attention, efficient architectures, mixture of experts) and system-level (speculative decoding, KV-cache management, batching and serving systems, kernels, offloading) techniques all count, as do benchmarks of inference efficiency.

Out of scope: methods that only make training or fine-tuning cheaper (e.g. parameter-efficient fine-tuning) with no inference saving; efficiency of non-language models (vision CNNs) unless the method is applied to LLMs; papers about LLM capabilities rather than cost.
